briefs.explicit:
MISSION BRIEF L-009
Units: metres, seconds, kilograms. Time starts at t = 0 when every robot leaves its start location.

Locations (x, y, zone):
- base: (0, 0), outdoor
- north roof: (135, -134), roof
- water tower top: (102, 100), roof
- pump house: (-67, -70), indoor
- workshop: (113, -87), indoor
- storage hall: (75, 2), indoor
- fuel depot: (122, 28), outdoor
- water tank: (80, -147), outdoor
- south yard: (1, -51), outdoor
- gate 2: (-114, -64), outdoor
- parking lot: (30, -19), outdoor

Robots:
- M1 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 10 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 3600 s, including the return to its start.
- G1 (rover): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 2.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 28 kg), camera. Endurance: 4380 s, including the return to its start.
- M2 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 6 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 2820 s, including the return to its start.
- G2 (rover): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 3 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 23 kg), camera. Endurance: 4860 s, including the return to its start.
- D1 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 8 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg). Endurance: 1080 s, including the return to its start.
- M3 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 10 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 2940 s, including the return to its start.
- G3 (rover): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 2.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 23 kg), camera. Endurance: 4320 s, including the return to its start.
- M4 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 8 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 2580 s, including the return to its start.

Tasks:
- T1: Tighten the valve at storage hall. Location: storage hall. Duration: 240 s. Needs: robotic arm. Deadline: finished by t = 660 s.
- T2: Deliver the replacement filter (14 kg) to water tank. Location: water tank. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 14 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 300 s.
- T3: Inspect north roof with a camera. Location: north roof. Duration: 90 s. Needs: camera. Deadline: finished by t = 480 s.
- T4: Deliver the sensor box (6 kg) to water tank. Location: water tank. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 6 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 360 s.
- T5: Tighten the valve at fuel depot. Location: fuel depot. Duration: 300 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T6: Tighten the valve at gate 2. Location: gate 2. Duration: 210 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T7: Tighten the valve at fuel depot. Location: fuel depot. Duration: 210 s. Needs: robotic arm. Deadline: finished by t = 540 s.
- T8: Tighten the valve at storage hall. Location: storage hall. Duration: 210 s. Needs: robotic arm. Can start only after T16 is finished.
- T9: Deliver the replacement filter (6 kg) to water tank. Location: water tank. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 6 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 300 s.
- T10: Inspect water tower top with a camera. Location: water tower top. Duration: 90 s. Needs: camera.
- T11: Deliver the pressure gauge (10 kg) to south yard. Location: south yard. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 10 kg).
- T12: Deliver the replacement filter (2 kg) to parking lot. Location: parking lot. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 2 kg).
- T13: Inspect north roof with a camera. Location: north roof. Duration: 150 s. Needs: camera.
- T14: Collect a soil sample (3 kg) at parking lot and keep it on board. Location: parking lot. Duration: 60 s. Needs: robotic arm, cargo carrier (payload 3 kg).
- T15: Photograph water tank for the condition report. Location: water tank. Duration: 150 s. Needs: camera.
- T16: Deliver the first-aid kit (6 kg) to storage hall. Location: storage hall. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 6 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 240 s.

Rules:
1. Every task is done by exactly one robot. A robot does its tasks one at a time, in the order you list them, travelling between task locations.
2. A robot can only do a task if it has the needed equipment, enough payload capacity, and can reach the task location.
3. A task that must start after another task waits until that task is finished, even if a different robot does it.
4. Each robot must be back at its start location before its endurance runs out.
5. Every task must be finished by t = 900 s.

Objective: minimise the finish time of the last task (the makespan).
briefs.informal:
Here's what we need from the robots today.

Positions are in metres from the base at (0, 0). Drones fly straight and can't go indoors; ground robots follow the road grid (so they travel |dx| + |dy|) and can't get onto roofs. Everyone leaves their start spot at time zero.

Places: north roof (135, -134, a rooftop); water tower top (102, 100, a rooftop); pump house (-67, -70, indoors); workshop (113, -87, indoors); storage hall (75, 2, indoors); fuel depot (122, 28, outside); water tank (80, -147, outside); south yard (1, -51, outside); gate 2 (-114, -64, outside); parking lot (30, -19, outside).

The fleet: M1 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 10 kg, moves at 1 m/s and lasts 60 minutes including getting back. G1 is a rover parked at base that hauls up to 28 kg at 2.5 m/s and runs for 73 minutes including the drive back. It has a camera. M2 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 6 kg, moves at 1 m/s and lasts 47 minutes including getting back. G2 is a rover parked at base that hauls up to 23 kg at 3 m/s and runs for 81 minutes including the drive back. It has a camera. D1, a quadcopter waiting at base, carries a camera, cruises at 8 m/s, lifts up to 2 kg and has 18 minutes of flight time, return trip included. M3 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 10 kg, moves at 1.5 m/s and lasts 49 minutes including getting back. G3 is a rover parked at base that hauls up to 23 kg at 2.5 m/s and runs for 72 minutes including the drive back. It has a camera. M4 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 8 kg, moves at 1.5 m/s and lasts 43 minutes including getting back.

Jobs:
(T1) The valve at storage hall needs tightening - that takes 4 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 11 minutes.
(T2) Get the replacement filter (14 kg) over to water tank - that takes 1 minute on site and it has to be finished within the first 5 minutes.
(T3) Do a visual check of north roof - that takes 1.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 8 minutes.
(T4) Water tank needs the sensor box, which weighs 6 kg - that takes 0.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 6 minutes.
(T5) Someone has to tighten the valve at fuel depot - that takes 5 minutes on site.
(T6) Someone has to tighten the valve at gate 2 - that takes 3.5 minutes on site.
(T7) Someone has to tighten the valve at fuel depot - that takes 3.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 9 minutes.
(T8) Someone has to tighten the valve at storage hall - that takes 3.5 minutes on site but only once the first-aid kit (T16) has arrived.
(T9) Water tank needs the replacement filter, which weighs 6 kg - that takes 0.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 5 minutes.
(T10) Do a visual check of water tower top - that takes 1.5 minutes on site.
(T11) South yard needs the pressure gauge, which weighs 10 kg - that takes 1 minute on site.
(T12) Drop the replacement filter off at parking lot; it weighs 2 kg - that takes 0.5 minutes on site.
(T13) Get eyes on north roof and check the panels - that takes 2.5 minutes on site.
(T14) Pick up a soil sample at parking lot and keep it on board; it weighs 3 kg - that takes 1 minute on site.
(T15) Grab photos of water tank for the condition report - that takes 2.5 minutes on site.
(T16) Storage hall needs the first-aid kit, which weighs 6 kg - that takes 1 minute on site and it has to be finished within the first 4 minutes.

Everything has to be wrapped up within 15 minutes of the start, and the sooner the last job finishes, the better. Every robot has to make it back to where it started before its battery runs out.
